history.text: Write a highly detailed, descriptive prompt of this image in English for an AI text-to-image generator (such as Midjourney, DALL-E, or Stable Diffusion). Describe the objects, background, style, lighting, color palette, and mood in detail. Do NOT include any introductory or concluding conversational text. Do not say 'Here is the prompt' or similar. Output ONLY the raw description of the image.

A majestic, ethereal phoenix woman, adorned with a golden crown, emerges from a vortex of vibrant flames. Her long, fiery red hair cascades around her, intertwined with wisps of smoke and embers. She wears a flowing gown made of intense orange and yellow flames, which also appear to be her lower body. Her skin has a luminous, almost translucent quality, and her eyes are a piercing gaze. Behind her, the majestic wings of a phoenix spread wide, glowing with golden and fiery hues. The background is a swirling, abstract blend of warm colors – oranges, reds, yellows, and hints of purple and pink – suggesting a cosmic or mystical realm. The lighting is dramatic and intense, emanating from the flames themselves, casting a warm, powerful glow on the woman and her surroundings. The overall mood is one of power, rebirth, and fierce beauty. The art style is highly detailed fantasy illustration, with a painterly, almost digital art aesthetic.
